contract.browser_execution: A Codex cell that requires browser proof runs inside the :workspace permission profile with only the browser-harness runtime Unix socket admitted.
contract.inner_codex: The inner Codex process bypasses its own sandbox only because the outer Codex sandbox already enforces workspace-only writes and the exact socket allowance.
contract.preflight_parity: The readiness probe uses the same workspace profile, workspace root, socket path, and browser temp path as the scored cell.
contract.non_browser_compatibility: Codex cells without a browser-proof gate retain the existing workspace-write execution path.
contract.artifact_lifecycle: Exact reflow-artifact lock, finalize, and finalize-unresolved commands are neutral bookkeeping and do not consume the one static verification budget.
contract.fail_closed: Compound helper commands and arbitrary second static verification commands remain non-neutral and are denied.
